hooks.command: echo '[Hook] Review changes before push...' >&2; echo '[Hook] Continuing with push (remove this hook to add interactive review)' >&2

uv run python3 -c "import sys, json, re; d=sys.stdin.read(); i=json.loads(d); p=i.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); (re.search(r'\.(md|txt)$',p) and not re.search(r'(README|CLAUDE|AGENTS|CONTRIBUTING|IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN|SKILL)\.md$',p)) and (sys.stderr.write('[Hook] BLOCKED: Unnecessary documentation file creation
[Hook] File: '+p+'
[Hook] Use README.md for documentation instead
'), sys.exit(2)); print(d,end='')"

PostToolUse.description: Run Bun quality gate after file edits (skipped unless the project defines the scripts)

hooks.command: [ -f package.json ] || exit 0; jq -e '.scripts.lint' package.json >/dev/null 2>&1 && { bun run lint || exit 1; }; jq -e '.scripts.typecheck' package.json >/dev/null 2>&1 && { bun run typecheck || exit 1; }; exit 0

PostToolUse.description: Log PR URL after gh pr create

hooks.command: uv run python3 -c "import sys, json, re; d=sys.stdin.read(); i=json.loads(d); cmd=i.get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''); m=re.search(r'gh pr create',cmd) and re.search(r'https://github.com/[^/]+/[^/]+/pull/\d+',i.get('tool_output',{}).get('output','')); m and sys.stderr.write('[Hook] PR created: '+m.group()+'\n[Hook] To review: gh pr review '+m.group().split('/')[-1]+' --repo '+'/'.join(m.group().split('/')[3:5])+'\n'); print(d,end='')"

PostToolUse.description: Lint edited Markdown (skipped unless uv and bunx are installed)

hooks.command: command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v bunx >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; uv run python3 -c "import sys, json, subprocess; d=sys.stdin.read(); i=json.loads(d); p=i.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); r=subprocess.run(['bunx','markdownlint-cli2',p],capture_output=True,text=True) if p else None; r and r.stdout.strip() and sys.stderr.write(r.stdout.strip()+'\n'); r and r.stderr.strip() and sys.stderr.write(r.stderr.strip()+'\n'); print(d,end='')"
